title: A NOT MET finding of kind feature is counted nowhere
what: Every finding of a check is counted in exactly one of open, queued, outside or met: a NOT MET finding of kind "feature" (or any kind other than inside/outside) at rank high or medium either counts as open or must carry a queue item, and relay check show names it.
why: 25 Oct, wt/claudemd: the check record holds F2 (rank high, verdict NOT MET, kind "feature"), and relay check show says "open 0, queued 0, outside: 0", so the merge hook would let it through with no word about it. The checker itself wrote "I don't know why the record shows open 0 while F2 is a HIGH finding not met". IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: /Users/amidman/relay/.worktrees/claudemd/.relay/checks/9abb0e27ba0cc189a69bbf25825bee9e57040a91.check.json: F2 kind feature, rank high, NOT MET; open_of gives 0.
pass_cases: A record with one high NOT MET finding of kind feature and no owner entry gives open 1 (or is refused at record time without a queue item).
A record whose findings are all MET gives open 0.
where: queued_of, outside_of; relay check show; plugins/core/hooks/merge.py
